en: Draupnir - Word has come that many Imperial raiding parties have appeared in Astania.
Iyolin - Has the Empire begun its full invasion?
Draupnir - Even the Empire would hardly attack while Cutis remains unsettled. And Beradin, who now runs the Empire, is not one to take reckless risks. Rather...
Iyolin - The Temple of the Sun?
Draupnir - So it seems. Given that Beradin has been digging up ruins everywhere lately, there is no reason he would leave the ruins in Silver Arrow's territory alone.
Iyolin - If Beradin is involved, we had better move too. I don't know what he is plotting, but it is surely nothing good for us.
Draupnir - GS should go with you. If the enemy really is after the Temple of the Sun, you will need a ranger who knows dungeons.
GS - Beradin... Somehow that name gives me a bad feeling.
Draupnir - They say he has been the Black Prince's friend since childhood. I don't know why the Black Prince hasn't shown himself lately, but he is surely up to something through Beradin.
